input: nums has n integers in [-1000000000,1000000000], lower and upper are safe integers with lower <= upper, and n*(n-1)/2 is safe. Empty input is accepted. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Number of unordered index pairs i<j whose sum lies in the inclusive interval [lower,upper]. Duplicate values at different indices count separately.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state. Sorting uses a private copy; output is a scalar count.
numeric: Pair sums/comparator differences have magnitude at most 2000000000. Each helper count is bounded by n choose 2; result is their nonnegative difference. Strict/inclusive modes avoid lower-1 or upper+1 overflow at safe-integer boundaries. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n log(n+1)+1) time and O(n+1) auxiliary copied-array/sort storage. Both fully charged two-pointer scans are O(n+1) time/O(1) extra space. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.

helpers.name: count_bounded_pairs
helpers.contract: Counts pairs in sorted values with sum < limit, or <= limit when inclusive. If smallest+largest fits, every remaining partner of smallest fits; otherwise largest has no valid partner with the current smallest.
helpers.cost: O(n+1) time/O(1) space per call; invoked twice with explicit strictness, full definition charged. Its complete definition is 374 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.

source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 675 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
